name: Sun Cleric: Sun Shield already reduces the chance to be hit by spells (#1573)
contract: 300348 is a plain APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE (aura 186) with no EffectSpellClassMask and no family filter, a stock WotLK generic self-buff needing no per-ability routing at all. BasePoints -4 resolves to -3 (DieSides 1), matching 'Reduces your chance to be hit by spells by 3%'. Learning a passive spell auto-applies its own aura (as with every other 'Rank: Passive' family-33 talent in this class), so the aura and its authored amount are present natively with no server code needed.
